_reason: Two zero floors, each naming one specific thing a gated document must not carry: a register defect the style lint can point at by line, and a waiver still standing over a finding that is gone. Zero because the rule is "never write this", not "do not write more of it than last time" — nothing here is seeded from what a document happened to measure before. The third key this file used to carry, max_redundancy_open, was exactly that kind of seeded bound (PRODUCT_SPEC.md ran 121 -> 119 -> 116, ARCHITECTURE.md 0 -> 15, each move needing its own written paragraph) and was removed 2026-09-02 on the owner's word, with the test half that read it. scripts/spec-redundancy-precheck.py still reports its candidate near-duplicate pairs for a person to read; it holds no document against a count.
